F1.description: Relay loop has only a 30-second idle timeout (_SELECT_TIMEOUT). No absolute wall-clock cap or per-session byte counter. A slow-drip upstream can hold a relay thread alive indefinitely.
F1.blast_radius: Zero when BROWSER_ENABLED=false (default). Defence-in-depth gap only when browser is explicitly enabled.
F1.status: OPEN — no fix required before Phase 3; may be addressed in a dedicated hardening pass.

F2.description: Uses rpartition(':') to split host_port. A bare unbracketed IPv6 literal would be mis-parsed. Chromium always sends well-formed proxy requests so not exploitable in practice. Parse failure is silent.
F2.blast_radius: Negligible under normal Chromium operation; only relevant if a non-Chromium HTTP client is pointed at the proxy.
F2.status: OPEN — no fix required before Phase 3; may be addressed in a dedicated hardening pass.
